sloka: वाली नाम महाप्राज्ञश्शक्रतुल्य पराक्रमः ।अध्यास्ते वानरश्श्रीमान् किष्किन्धामतुलप्रभाम् ॥४-११-२१॥।।
transliteration: vālī nāma mahāprājñaśśakratulya parākramaḥ ।adhyāste vānaraśśrīmān kiṣkindhāmatulaprabhām ॥4-11-21॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali, son of Indra, is a wise, powerful and prosperous monkey. He resides at Kishkinda, a city of incomparable glory.
